title: Claude Code agents, public
description: Spend, tokens, tools and traces from Claude Code's OpenTelemetry export. Spend and tokens are summed from one event per API call.

panels.title: Cost (range)
panels.description: Sum of cost_usd over every API call in the range, as Claude Code prices it.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cost_usd | unwrap cost_usd [$__range])))

panels.title: Tokens (range)
panels.description: Input, output, cache read and cache write tokens of every API call in the range.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep input_tokens | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep output_tokens | unwrap output_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_read_tokens | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_creation_tokens | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range])))

panels.title: Cache read share (range)
panels.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache. Drops after compaction or when the system prompt changes.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_read_tokens | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) / (sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep input_tokens | unwrap input_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_read_tokens | unwrap cache_read_tokens [$__range])) + sum(sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_creation_tokens | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [$__range]))))

sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" [$__range])))

sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="user_prompt" [$__range])))

sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="tool_result" [$__range])))

panels.title: Cost per hour by model
panels.description: Cost of the API calls in the trailing hour.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum by (model) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep model, cost_usd | unwrap cost_usd [1h])))

panels.title: Tokens / s by type
panels.description: cacheRead dominating is healthy: long sessions re-read their context cheaply.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep input_tokens | unwrap input_tokens [5m])))

sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep output_tokens | unwrap output_tokens [5m])))

sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_read_tokens | unwrap cache_read_tokens [5m])))

sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum(rate({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep cache_creation_tokens | unwrap cache_creation_tokens [5m])))

panels.title: Cost by source (main, subagent, auxiliary)
panels.description: Trailing hour. sdk is the desktop app's main loop, agent:* are subagents, the rest are side calls (prompt suggestions, compaction, web fetch). Subagent fan-out shows up here first.

targets.expr: sum without (instance, job, process_owner, os_type, os_version, host_arch, service_version, service_name, terminal_type, mcp_server_name, mcp_tool_name, skill_name, agent_name, session_id, user_account_uuid, user_email, organization_id, claude_deployment_mode, start_type) (sum by (query_source) (sum_over_time({service_name=~"claude-code.*"} | event_name="api_request" | keep query_source, cost_usd | unwrap cost_usd [1h])))
